slides.texte_overlay:
How to look extremely
niche this summer
Wear linen in neutral colours. A loose white or beige shirt, rolled sleeves, light trousers. Effortless and perfect for hot days.
Carry a paperback everywhere. A classic novel in your pocket at the beach or the café looks better than any accessory.
Learn to sail or paddleboard. A summer skill on the water feels adventurous and gets you outdoors every weekend.
Wear simple leather sandals or clean canvas shoes. Comfortable, classic and better than heavy sneakers in the heat.
Know the history of the places you visit. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and every summer trip feels richer.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Every summer trip feels richer.

slides.texte_overlay: Take film photos. A small camera and a few rolls. Waiting to see your pictures makes the memories feel special.
Get a light tan the healthy way. Shade at midday, sunscreen always. Looking fresh beats looking burnt. Enjoy the sun wisely.
